D: Six heroes team up to stop Loki's invasion of New York.
P: Serve the shawarma during the end credits, when the team eats in silence.
S: Stark Tower seared tuna and wasabi bites
drinks at the top of the tower, before Loki arrives

Sesame-crusted tuna seared rare on crisp cucumber with wasabi mayo and pickled ginger, beside mini Yorkshires stuffed with rare beef and horseradish. Roll 300g sashimi tuna in sesame seeds and sear 30 seconds a side, then slice. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp wasabi. Top 16 thick cucumber rounds with mayo, tuna and pickled ginger. Whisk 2 eggs, 100g flour and 125ml milk, pour into a hot oiled mini muffin tin and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Fill with sliced rare roast beef and horseradish cream.
Chickpea hummus topped with crisp spiced lamb mince, pine nuts and flatbread

Silky tahini hummus topped with sizzling cumin-spiced lamb mince, pine nuts and chilli oil, with warm flatbread for scooping. Blitz 2 drained 400g tins chickpeas with 100g tahini, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon, salt and 80ml ice water for 3 minutes until very smooth. Fry 250g lamb mince in oil until crisp, adding 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp paprika. Toast 30g pine nuts. Swirl the hummus onto a plate, spoon the hot lamb over, add pine nuts, chilli oil and parsley. Warm 4 flatbreads.
Mixed nuts roasted with honey, butter and thyme
Mixed nuts tossed in honey, butter, thyme and sea salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes.
M: Yoghurt and spice marinated chicken in flatbread with garlic sauce and pickled turnips
Chicken thighs marinated in yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon and lemon, grilled and sliced. Warm flatbread, toum (garlic, oil, lemon emulsified), pickles, tomato and parsley.
W: Iced butter cookies in red, white and blue shield rings with a white star
Sugar cookie rounds iced in concentric red and white rings with a blue centre and white star.
K: Asgardian honey ginger beer or mead
Honey and lemon topped with ginger beer, or chilled mead for the grown-ups
Ginger beer stirred with honey and lemon over ice, or real mead for the grown-ups.

dishes.make_ahead: Hummus up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the chickpeas with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice, salt and ice water until very smooth.
Fry the lamb in a little oil until crisp, adding the cumin, cinnamon and paprika.
Toast the pine nuts and warm the flatbreads.

veg.n: Post-battle hummus with spiced plant-based mince
veg.make_ahead: Hummus up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the chickpeas with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice, salt and ice water until very smooth.
Fry the plant-based mince in the olive oil until crisp, adding the cumin, cinnamon and paprika.
Toast the pine nuts and warm the flatbreads.
Swirl the hummus onto a plate and spoon the hot mince over.
Add pine nuts, chilli oil and parsley.
Heat the oven to 170C. Toss the nuts with the honey, butter and thyme.
Roast on a lined tray, stirring once.
Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm and stir as they cool so they don't stick together.
Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon and lemon juice. Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Grill the chicken until cooked through and charred.
Rest and slice.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with chicken, garlic sauce, pickled turnips, tomato and parsley.
Cut the cauliflower into small florets and mix with the yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon, lemon juice and olive oil.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Spread on a lined tray and roast at 230C, turning once, until tender and charred at the edges.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with the cauliflower, garlic sauce, pickled turnips, tomato and parsley.
Beat the butter, sugar and egg, then mix in the flour.
Cut 12 rounds and bake at 180C. Cool completely.
Mix the icing sugar with water to a thick icing and tint some red and some blue.
Ice the rings, add a blue centre and a white star.

s.note: Chickpea hummus topped with crisp spiced lamb mince, pine nuts and flatbread
s.how: Blitz 2 drained 400g tins chickpeas with 100g tahini, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon, salt and 80ml ice water for 3 minutes until very smooth. Fry 250g lamb mince in oil until crisp, adding 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp paprika. Toast 30g pine nuts. s.note: Mixed nuts roasted with honey, butter and thyme
s.how: Toss 400g mixed nuts with 2 tbsp honey, 30g melted butter and chopped thyme. Roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring once. Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm and stir as they cool so they don't stick together.

m.note: Yoghurt and spice marinated chicken in flatbread with garlic sauce and pickled turnips
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 150g yoghurt, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp each cumin, coriander and paprika, a pinch of cinnamon and lemon juice overnight. Grill and slice. Serve in 4 warm flatbreads with garlic sauce, pickled turnips, tomato and parsley.

w.note: Iced butter cookies in red, white and blue shield rings with a white star
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut 12 rounds and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Mix 300g icing sugar with water to a thick icing, tint some red and some blue, and ice rings with a blue centre and white star.
